en: What do you do around here?
Well, I'm with the Rada. Don't worry, no incoming speech.
Right now I'm studying different factions and settlements, trying to convince some folks to work together through the Rada. And you're a Vulture, correct? What's your name?
And you? You're a scavenger, a Vulture, correct? What's your name?
I'm Rodion. Why do you ask?
Not telling you about me.
Learned a few mantras, went on a few singles and doubles.
Yes, I am a Vulture.
How did it go again – "We have but Tongue and Fangs". I don't know the life like you do, but I've been a Vulture before, if only for a short while.
Tough racket... If it interests you, come talk about what the Rada can do for you. Help us understand. We won't try to recruit you. It's just – you're not alone.
We won't try to recruit you. It's just – you're not alone.
Not your concern.
Ha ha, guess not. Didn't mean to pry.
But if you ever want to talk about your work, I'd love to know more. Just professional curiosity – figuring out Zalesye's factions is what I do.
How exactly could the Rada help?
Well, for example... After my stint as a Vulture, I had an idea to convert the old bunkers in the Dola into scavenger outposts.
Get a task force together to clear them, stash some ammo, build sniper's nests. Like forward operating bases in the military – Palatines would know about those.
It's just one idea, though. I'm sure you'd have plenty more to contribute.
You look down on us Vultures - feel it a mile away.
Okay. Let's talk about that. What, exactly, makes you think so?
Rada hide behind buzzwords to fake work.
Organizing, collectivization – what does it all mean, yeah? Thing is, it depends. It's not specific, like tilling a field, fixing a water filter, shooting Bandits.
Well, the thing is – it depends. I don't get to say I'm getting up in the morning to do something specific – tilling a field, fixing a water filter, shooting Bandits in the face.
You talk to people, get ideas, help with their work, they help you – it's all in motion, at all times. Hence the buzzwords. Try it for a few days, you'll understand.
But if you tried it – just a few days – I'm sure you'd understand.
Rada looks down on people like me.
Do we now? Is that why we're desperate for any bit of communication we can get with you? Yeah, we see the world differently. Doesn't stop me from wanting to talk.

And the Mudlarks? Will it be fine to leave them alone? Every time I go to Dazbog, they're less concerned about throwing bodies in the Lake and more about just piling them up into totems – which is fine since it's their culture, but what if it comes to affect us all in the future? Fuck do we do about that, then?
Can't just worry about ourselves and ignore everyone else – and expect society to not continue to be the same fucked up shit it currently is.
But we need to talk and figure things out as a group, even if it's a grueling process! But dare to try, and you're the elitist?! It's so fucking exhaustive...
Ha ha... Guess that kinda proves your point, huh? Maybe I'm a stuck-up asshole after all. Let's talk about something else...
You do seem overworked.
Ugh... Didn't mean to let that show. It's just... The more I study different groups, the more desperate I become. Sometimes it seems simple to fix things, just one or two steps missing...
The more I study different groups in this region, the more I suggest ideas to the Rada... Sometimes it seems like it'd be simple to fix things, there's just one or two steps missing...
And sometimes it seems like even a marginal improvement is a thousand miles away, behind some impossible fog, destructive like the Mist.
It saps away at your soul, this routine – and I'm sure, as a Vulture, you can relate to endless, hopeless cycles.
What other ideas do you have for Zalesye?
I have a few...
What else do you have on Zalesye's factions?
Let's see...
What did you make of the people in those camps?
Gotta get going.
About Mechanists.
How do we deal with Mechanists?
I've been trying to get Mechanists to collaborate more with the rest of people... Stop hogging their technological achievements.
Imagine if even Commonfolk had access to their understanding of filters, weapon repairs, sewing, farming...! The leap in our quality of life if that was available to everyone!
Sounds good – but then the Mechanists lose their purpose.
Not necessarily! Collectivizing their knowledge helps guide them to a new purpose – they are still scientists, still leading our technological progress...
It's not binary – "they had a grasp on our tools, now they don't". It's dialectical! Society will negate, contain and reconstruct the Mechanist at the same time.
And while we figure that out, the Rada will be there, making sure no one goes hungry. It's not some perfect process – just something to work towards. It's possible.
It's not some perfect process or utopia – just something to work *towards*. It's *possible*.
Bad idea – they'd never agree to that.
That's the thing – they can be a bit, you know, selfish. We have to offer something in exchange, but...
All we have is a fledgling network of provisions – in our bunkers and stashes, we get to promise a small group of people that they won't go hungry.
But that is not enticing for some of the most well-off people in Zalesye, is it...
About Commonfolk.
Any plan for the Commonfolk?
We need to get them in a group, for sure. Even if it means creating a group, specifically – I don't know, farmers? Cooks? Suppliers of all sorts – maybe get the merchants together...?
Can't just have a mass of people waddle around the wasteland with no sense of community. Even beggars need to feel like they belong, in the absence of what we used to call a "country".
Take Marko, for example – he's an artist and social organizer, and that's important to him even on the worst days. All Commonfolk should have that: purpose, as it relates to others.
About Gunners, Palatines.
You haven't said much about Gunners or Palatines.
Well... I mean, we all have our own affinities, right? And I am not particularly suited for interacting with those groups...
I just hate all the violence. Worst thing about my time as a Vulture – defending myself from Bandits. I... Don't even like to talk about it.
Bogdan's told me multiple times, and rationally, I know he's right – having a sort of military force, in any community, is indispensable... But I don't... I don't like it.
About Mudlarks.
What about the Mudlarks? They're very... Isolated.
I want to spend more time with them, and get help from the Rada to study how they communicate.
There's a couple of them – Ilya, Gavron – who can pretty much talk like we do. But we need to meet them halfway, understand their rites and beliefs, before we can really have them as allies.
Well, they only work as corpse-bearers for us out of some very immediate interests... Soon as they grow in number, gain traction... We'll be seeing an increase in Mist, for sure.
About Bandits.
Are the Bandits a faction, in your eyes?
Yes. Well, kind of. Like Vultures, it's a loosely defined group... Except right now we simply cannot speak to them. Been shooting each other on sight for far too long.
But unlike Vultures, right now we simply *cannot* speak to them. Been shooting each other on sight for far too long – dehumanized them, denied them an opportunity to change.
I know it's easier said than done, but we have to start considering how Bandits become Bandits – and how do we stop it or at least deal with them, negotiate.
Can't have them as an amorphous mass of target practice. It terrorizes us and justifies the militaristic posturing of Gunners and Palatines... More gunshots all around. The effect compounds...
Might seem unfair to you and me who are not aggressive – but we need to give them names, deal with them as people. Only way to control the situation a bit.
Why don't we talk about something else.
I need to go, now.

Yes! I've been squatting here to try and reach out to nearby dwellers, since we of the Rada want to invite people who are struggling to our community down South. But I've heard so many gunshots around here, and I got scared...

The Palatines don't do scouting work for us, they're just guards. But you, Vulture, maybe you'd help? There's two small camps West of here - one across the road, the other up North – could you go there and tell me if they're, y'know... Safe?

Problem is - we don't really know who lives there, and I've been squatting here with the intention of establishing contact... But there's been too many gunshots, and I am a pacifist. So I can't really do this alone.
Are they Gunners trying to muscle in on Palatine territory? Are they bandits picking off Vultures who try to go carelessly into the Dola? Or are they squatters, just trying to get by?
I could help.
Cool.
The huntsmen at Fyodor Woods, the local thugs at North Arcadia...
I'll help you.
Thank you. I'll make it worth your time!
Need to think about it.
Oh, ok. Please don't take long.
Remind me what I had to look for.
Well...
I'll get back to it.
Alright...
Oh? What did you find out?
(Give Letter to Ayda.)
Oh, no... They were squatters, thought they'd found a nice pond. Didn't know about Tormentils.
Oh, no... They thought they'd struck gold with that camp. Wanted to make a fish pond...
They were probably not from around here; wouldn't know about the Tormentils and Woundworts.
Seemed like a loving couple, too. If only they'd been warned...
(Give Settler's Warning.)
A group of Bandits, huh... Trying to pick off Palatines. Yet they couldn't even survive you - no offense.
Hmm. So, they were trying to harass the Palatines – maybe even pick off a couple straddlers – like the Gunners are doing?
Seems a lofty goal for such a small group. They couldn't even survive you - no offense.
Maybe they were stupid and arrogant. Maybe they were just desperate... Guess we'll never know.
Sad, isn't it. Two sets of people - one killed by a cruel corruption of nature, the other suicidally throwing itself into conflict for nothing but scraps...
As sad as I am to learn of their deaths - and of you having a shootout because of me - I still have hope. This is climbable. We'll see a way out soon enough...
And my reward?
Either way, you've earned your pay. I'll get back to my work...
You're forgetting something.
Of course, sorry. Here you go.
What did you make of the squatter situation?
Well...
Call me naive, but I think we could've helped them. The Rada, I mean. Marking dangerous spots with signs, not letting squatters go carelessly into dangerous places just because they look cozy.
This stuff, it builds upon itself, goes a long way. Makes the world around us more inviting, friendlier, little by little by little. But you kinda need "faith" in a pretty tiring process.
Tell me about those settlers.
Yeah, about those Bandits... See, I'm not sure what we could've done. There's certainly a structural problem behind their violence. Hunger, maybe? Desperation?
One possibility, though, is that if Palatines weren't building that mini-fortress, Arcadia, while acting like an invincible military force, this situation wouldn't have happened.
There's a structural problem, right there - beneath the surface of "Bandits bad". Palatines attract Bandits and Gunners, they're macho competition.
No more questions.
Okay...
A Vulture, approaching *me*...?! N-Name's Mila. Um, I actually could use some help...
Hello, scavenger. Having a good day?
Oh, hi there. Didn't notice you.
Hey there. How are you?
Can we talk?
I have some questions for you.
Want to talk a bit.
Can we trade?
Have anything to trade?
Got some items to trade.
Said you needed help.
Need help with something?
You said you needed something.
I've investigated those camps.
I'm back from searching those camps.
Nearby folks met a bad end.
Either way, you've more than earned your pay. Thank you, sir. Guess I'll be moving back to the Mire soon... Gotta continue my work.
Anyway... Thank you, Rodion. Guess this means I'll be moving back to the Mire soon.
Sure, let me see what I have.
Ok, let's do this.
Hmm, I have some things I can trade...
Sure, let's.
See you later, Vulture.
See you later, Rodion.
Until some other time.
Take care!
Alright, see you.
Oh, I see... Well, it's just professional curiosity, think nothing of it. I've met a few Vultures... Actually became one for a while.
Hello, Rodion. Well, it's just professional curiosity, I guess! I've met a few Vultures... Sorta became one for a while.
God... I'm sorry. I'm... Tired. Shouldn't have said those things.
God... I'm sorry, Rodion. I'm... Tired. Shouldn't have said those things.
The squatters and the settlers, right? Everyone dying like some Greek tragedy.
The squatters and the settlers, right?
I'll help make the roads safe.
Thank you so much – and please be careful.
Gonna think about it.
Of course, no problem. It's a dangerous task, after all.
Got anything else?
Anytime.
Anything happens, let me know.
I'll find some items for you.
I hope you do...
Gotta think on it a bit.
I see. Let me know what you decide.
Got any other requests?
Don't worry about it.
See you around.
Anything I can do to help?
Got an errand I can take off your hands?
Got jobs for a Vulture?
We’ve been having trouble with packs of Mutants attacking Commonfolk not too far from here... Would you please help us neutralize those monsters?
It’s been hell getting to and from each different place I work at, lately... Too many Mutants on the roads. I’m willing to pay if you take them out for me...
This is fantastic! Thanks for your help. Here's your reward.
Great – and you're safe, too. Might need your help again...
You've really helped us all out, Vulture. Thank you. Here's what I promised.
The Rada asked me to talk to different groups and see if we can round up extra medical supplies. Would you mind helping out?
I need medical supplies for the Rada. We’re responsible for many Commonfolk, after all. Thought about hiring you to find more.
This will be a huge help... Thank you. Here you go.
Just what we needed! Thanks. And here's your reward.
This will make a real difference these next few days. Thank you.
I don't have any other work for Vultures right now. Sorry.
Haven't heard about work for scavengers from my colleagues at the Rada. Maybe try again later.
Sorry, got nothing else. Maybe some other time.
Seems like a waste of life all around.
Why worry? We have no control over this.
We could have done something about it, I believe. Not let things get to where they are.
Want to talk a bit.
Can we talk?
I have some questions for you.
Got some items to trade.
Can we trade?
Have anything to trade?
I think the Vultures' meritocratic thinking is misguided. I also think leaving the Mudlarks alone with their corpse totems is a bad idea. I'd change a million things about each faction.
I hate to do this, but... I need a Bandit squad taken care of. It's just been... Too difficult... Getting around here.
A request came in from Dubravka for me to hire a Vulture to kill some Bandits. I don't like this, but they must have their reasons.
They're gone? ... I guess it can't be helped. Here's your pay.
They're all dead, huh? Well, not like they would've given us a chance to chat.
I'll handle it.
I know. Stay safe.
Gotta think on this.
No use postponing this. It's just how things are.
Got anything else?
Cheer up, Mila.
Don't feel any remorse in killing those shitheads.
